claims: Los Angeles Lakers defeated the Miami Heat 130-120 on November 2, 2025 at Crypto.com Arena.
Los Angeles Lakers won 134-126 against the Miami Heat on March 19, 2026 at the Kaseya Center.
LeBron James played his 1,611th game on March 19, 2026, tying Robert Parish for the most all-time games played, notes heavy.com.
Luka Doncic recorded 60 points, 10 assists, and 9 rebounds in the Los Angeles Lakers' win against the Miami Heat on March 19, 2026, says Yahoo Sports.
Bam Adebayo led the Miami Heat with 28 points on March 19, 2026.
Los Angeles Lakers have won nine of the last ten meetings between the Los Angeles Lakers and the Miami Heat, reports The Times of India.
Los Angeles Lakers won 117-108 at Miami against the Miami Heat on January 15, 2025, according to ESPN.
